proof:
1. Graph facts. From graphPoint x y = toLp 2 (Fin.append (ofLp x) (ofLp y)): graphPoint x y - graphPoint x' y' = graphPoint (x - x') (y - y') (coordinatewise), and ||graphPoint x y||^2 = ||x||^2 + ||y||^2 (split the coordinate sum over Fin (n+l) with Fin.sum_univ_add).
2. F is Lipschitz on D. For x', y' in D, since q is a linear isometry, ||F x' - F y'||^2 = ||graphPoint (x' - y') (f x' - f y')||^2 = ||x' - y'||^2 + ||f x' - f y'||^2 <= (1 + L^2) ||x' - y'||^2. So F is K-Lipschitz on D with K := sqrt(1 + L^2), regarded as an element of R>=0; in particular F is continuous on D.
3. Image bound. For every set E contained in D: μHE[n](F(E)) <= K^n vol(E). Indeed μHE[n] = c_n • μH[n] on every Borel metric space, with the same scalar c_n := addHaarScalarFactor (volume on EuclideanSpace R (Fin n)) μH[n] (euclideanHausdorffMeasure_def). As F is K-Lipschitz on E, μH[n](F(E)) <= K^n μH[n](E) (LipschitzOnWith.hausdorffMeasure_image_le with d = n >= 0); multiplying by c_n gives μHE[n](F(E)) <= K^n μHE[n](E), and on R^n = EuclideanSpace R (Fin n) one has μHE[n] = volume (EuclideanSpace.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_eq_volume).
4. Push-forward. Let μ_D := volume.restrict D. Since D is measurable and F is continuous on D, F is AEMeasurable for μ_D (ContinuousOn.aemeasurable). Let ν := Measure.map F μ_D. For every measurable B in R^{n+l}, ν(B) = μ_D(F^{-1}(B)) (map_apply_of_aemeasurable) = vol(F^{-1}(B) ∩ D) (Measure.restrict_apply', valid for an arbitrary set because D is measurable).
5. Comparison of measures. Put Γ := q '' graphOver f D; Γ = F(D) (Set.image_image). For measurable B, B ∩ Γ = F(D ∩ F^{-1}(B)) (a point F(x') with x' in D lies in B iff x' lies in F^{-1}(B)). By step 3 applied to E := D ∩ F^{-1}(B), (μHE[n].restrict Γ)(B) = μHE[n](B ∩ Γ) <= K^n vol(D ∩ F^{-1}(B)) = K^n ν(B). Hence μHE[n].restrict Γ <= K^n • ν as measures (Measure.le_iff: it suffices to compare measurable sets).
6. Integrals. For measurable g >= 0, ∫⁻_Γ g dμHE[n] = ∫⁻ g d(μHE[n].restrict Γ) <= ∫⁻ g d(K^n • ν) (lintegral_mono' with the inequality of measures) = K^n ∫⁻ g dν (lintegral_smul_measure) = K^n ∫⁻_D g(F x') dx' (lintegral_map', g measurable and F AEMeasurable for μ_D). Finally K^n = ENNReal.ofReal(sqrt(1 + L^2)^n), the constant in the claim.
